posts.content_md:
Hi,

I've been using super bright LEDs to illuminate H1 Transmissions for a while, with excellent results. This makes me think that the bandwidth must be very low - as the image is really clear - upto about an inch from the film.

I just wondered what would happen if I tried to make a hologram using an LED rather than a laser? - would this make a hologram even if very unclear?

Thanks, Rick.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: The band width on a diode is anywhere from 10 to 30 nm. You will need something like .00001nm. (I didn't do the math but I have in the past, so I might be off by an order of magnitude but you get the idea.)
